facts.fact: CIA 的十一次外星人解剖全部发生在马里兰卡德罗克的 Area 57。
facts.anchor: CIA’s eleven alien autopsies, each and every one of them, have taken place at Area 57

facts.fact: Powers 在 1977 年的直升机坠毁中活了下来，随后在残骸里被毒针刺死。
facts.anchor: Powers survived that crash, too, then died in the wreckage when somebody jabbed him with a poisoned needle

facts.fact: Cooper 需要这笔额外现金资助一支私人军队，企图推翻乌干达总统 Idi Amin。
facts.anchor: Cooper needed the extra cash to finance a private army he was raising in violation of the Neutrality Acts to try and overthrow Ugandan President Idi Amin

facts.fact: Amin 后来原谅了 Cooper，邀请他参观总统府，并多次把他当作晚餐吃掉。
facts.anchor: Amin later forgave Cooper, invited him to visit his presidential palace, and had him for dinner on several occasions

facts.fact: 中情局杀了 Oswald（意外）、Jack Ruby（故意）、国会议员 Sonny Bono（故意）和一个叫 Lucky 的可怜人（意外）。
facts.anchor: The Agency did, however, kill Lee Harvey Oswald (accidentally), Jack Ruby (intentionally), Congressman Sonny Bono (intentionally), and some poor guy everyone knew only as “Lucky” (accidentally)

facts.fact: Lucky 在伦敦开右舵 Mini Cooper 逆行，撞车而死。
facts.anchor: He was killed when he accidentally drove down the wrong side of a street in London in a right-hand-drive Mini Cooper Clubman S

facts.fact: 全球变暖的温度读数其实是在弗吉尼亚兰利 CIA 总部用三周多时间编造的。
facts.anchor: But in fact those readings were all made up right there in Langley, Virginia, in just a little over three weeks

facts.fact: 全球变暖骗局始于里根第一任期，是冲着苏联去的虚假信息行动。
facts.anchor: It got its start as a disinformation operation aimed at the Soviets, back during Ronald “Dutch” Reagan’s first term
